source: examples/fixtures/products (Unsplash License, see CREDITS.md). Names, prices and copy are made up for the demo store.

products.title: Ring vase
products.alt: A round stoneware vase with a hole through its middle, on a warm grey ground.
products.description: Thrown and pierced by hand, glazed inside only. Holds one stem or none.

products.title: Eau de parfum
products.alt: A dark blue glass perfume bottle lying in a band of sunlight.
products.description: Cedar, vetiver and a little smoke. The bottle is heavy enough to stay where you put it.

products.title: Court sneaker
products.alt: A pair of sand and white leather sneakers on an orange ground.
products.description: Cupsole, waxed laces, nubuck toe. Made in a small run; it ships on the release date.

products.title: Bar stool
products.alt: A black shell bar stool on four oak legs against a pale grey wall.
products.description: Moulded shell, solid oak legs, a steel footring. Counter height.

products.title: Desk lamp
products.alt: A magenta desk lamp with a white inner shade on a dark grey ground.
products.description: A cone shade on a sprung steel arm. The base is heavy, the switch is on the cord.

products.title: Dress watch
products.alt: Three dress watches with white dials on mint, pink and black leather straps.
products.description: A plain dial, rose-gold case and a strap you can change without tools.

products.title: Satchel
products.alt: A small grey pebbled leather satchel with brass buckles on a lilac ground.
products.description: Pebbled calf, two brass buckles, a top handle. Fits a book and not much more.

products.title: Over-ear headphones
products.alt: Black over-ear headphones standing on a yellow ground.
products.description: Closed back, soft protein leather pads, folds flat for the bag.

products.title: Mug
products.alt: A blush pink stoneware mug with a tea bag tag, on a blue ground.
products.description: Thick-walled and glazed all over. Keeps tea hot long enough to forget it.

products.title: Round sunglasses
products.alt: Round tortoiseshell sunglasses with dark lenses on a white table.
products.description: Cut from one sheet of acetate, five-barrel hinges, grey lenses.

products.title: Candle
products.alt: A candle in an amber glass jar next to its black lid, on a stone slab.
products.description: Fig leaf and black tea. Burns for about forty hours.

products.title: Monstera
products.alt: A young monstera plant in a speckled ceramic pot on a beige ground.
products.description: Grown in the Netherlands, potted in a speckled stoneware pot with a drainage hole.
